definitions.explanation: Relating to an individual's personal matters or private life, as opposed to public or official matters.

examples.japanese: これは{私的|してき}な{問題|もんだい}だ。
{私的|してき}な{時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: I want to value my private time.

examples.japanese: {私的|してき}に{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went on a personal trip.

notes:
NA-ADJECTIVE ({形容動詞|けいようどうし}): Uses な before nouns and に as adverb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{私的|してき}な{問題|もんだい}: a private matter
・{私的|してき}な{理由|りゆう}: personal reasons
・{私的|してき}に: privately, personally

NOTE ON READING: Same reading as {指摘|してき} (pointing out) - different words.

ANTONYM: {公的|こうてき} (public, official)
